openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. Address lead: м. Рівне, вул. М. Карнаухова, 53 (osvita.ua directory). A zaxid.net news item (date not shown in results) reports that part of the former Rivne MSEK building at вул. Стельмаха, 6 was transferred to the academy for classrooms and expansion of a simulation centre - consistent with ongoing operation in Rivne. 2026 admission pages exist on vstup.osvita.ua. Related: Luhansk State Medical University is reported (suspilne.media) to have started work in Rivne oblast after relocation - a different institution.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead at all for admission of foreign applicants, an international office, or English-medium teaching (English and Ukrainian searches both returned nothing); all surfaced offers are domestic nursing/pharmacy bachelor and vocational allied-health programmes.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No medicine (222) or dentist-level dentistry degree programme surfaced; the two '221 Стоматологія' programmes are professional-junior-bachelor allied-health programmes (dental hygiene, dental technology) and must not be presented as dentistry degrees.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Ownership label conflict: the official name form 'Комунальний заклад вищої освіти ... Рівненської обласної ради' indicates communal ownership, while the osvita.ua directory labels it 'Форма власності: Державна' and the vstup directory says 'державної форми власності і підпорядковується обласній раді' - communal is the better-supported reading but unconfirmed by a statute or founder decision.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Domain 'mcollege.rv.ua' is a college-era hostname given only by third-party directories (osvita.ua, vstup.osvita.ua); not confirmed from the institution or a government register.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name/location confusion risks: Luhansk State Medical University is reported to operate in Rivne oblast after relocation (suspilne.media); Rivne State Humanitarian University and the Open International University 'Ukraine' Rivne Institute appear in 'Rivne' searches; 'Рокитнівський фаховий медичний коледж Рівненської медичної академії' is listed as a structural subdivision of the academy (vstup.osvita.ua/y2025/r18/4412/).
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The midwifery lead sits under vstup.osvita.ua institution id 933, not the academy's id 729 - attribution unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: osvita.ua directory states master-level qualification exists, but no master's programme page was found; the pharmacy bachelor page reflects a 2021-2024 cohort, so current pharmacy intake is unconfirmed.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Only fee found is a 2022 contract fee (31,400 UAH/year, nursing bachelor) - outdated; no current fees.

Licence and accreditation of every programme unverified.

Skeptic's note: Qualifying degree leads are nursing bachelor (2026 admission page) and pharmacy bachelor (only a 2021-2024 cohort page; current pharmacy intake unconfirmed). No medicine (222) or dentist-level dentistry lead; the two '221 Стоматологія' programmes are professional-junior-bachelor allied-health programmes (dental hygiene, dental technology) and must not be shown as dentistry degrees.
Skeptic's note: Domain mcollege.rv.ua is a college-era hostname given only by osvita.ua-family directories (medium confidence); not confirmed by the institution or a register.
